nodes.summary: Invariant events of the Bernoulli product measure have probability `0` or `1`.
nodes.title: Bernoulli zero-one law for infinite groups acting finite-to-one

nodes.summary: Coordinates are independent under the Bernoulli product measure. See also Mathlib's `ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun_infinitePi`, of which this is a special case.
nodes.title: Independence of coordinates under the Bernoulli product measure

nodes.summary: The Bernoulli product measure is ergodic under every action of an infinite group with injective orbit maps.
nodes.title: Ergodicity of Bernoulli measures under free infinite-group actions

nodes.summary: A measure on `ConfigSpace E` is ergodic for the shift action of `G` if it is translation invariant and every measurable set with `shift g ⁻¹' s = s` for all `g` has measure `0` or `μ univ`. See also Mathlib's `ErgodicSMul`, which asks the same for a.e.-invariant sets.
nodes.title: Ergodic measure on configuration space

nodes.summary: A measure on `ConfigSpace E` is translation invariant if every shift `shift g`, `g : G`, preserves it.
nodes.title: Translation-invariant measure on configuration space

nodes.summary: `shift` is Mathlib's `arrowAction` of `G` on functions `E → Bool`.
nodes.title: Configuration shift is the action on functions

nodes.summary: The shift of a configuration by `g : G`: `(shift g ω) e = ω (g⁻¹ • e)`. This is the action `arrowAction` of Mathlib on functions out of `E`.
nodes.title: Shift of a configuration by a group element

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
